product_metadata.title: Rechargeable Milk Frother Handheld Electric Foam Maker with Stainless Whisk 3 Speed for Bulletproof Coffee Latte Cappuccino Hot Chocolate Black Extra 16 Pcs Art Stencils
features: Rechargeable Milk Frother for Coffee Latte Cappuccino Hot Chocolate.Foam maker's good choice.

Professional milk frother with 2 stainless steel whisks and 16 templates to make all of your favorite coffee, keto, frappe, latte, cappuccino and hot chocolate drinks. Also works great for getting smooth batter and fluffy whipped cream.
Multiple speeds 3 speeds to choose from so you get the control and consistency that you desire to make the perfect drink or whipped cream each and every time.
Durable, powerful and with new easier tool attachment that lasts longer than others, making this a must have for any kitchen or coffee area.
Easy to store so it doesnt eat up counter space leaving you free to use your counter tops for other kitchen needs. Comes with USB charging cable for easy charging.
